ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$ has its center at $O$, and $\angle BOC=110^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\odot O$ is the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$ and $\angle BOC=110^\circ$,
\[ \therefore \angle A=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=\frac{1}{2}\times 110^\circ=\boxed{55^\circ}. \]

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, and points A, B, and C are all on the circumference; O is located inside the circle as the center of the circle. Line segments AB, AC, and BC form the inscribed triangle ABC, and line segments OB and OC connect from the center of the circle to B and C on the circumference, so ∠BOC is the central angle corresponding to arc BC. The problem gives ∠BOC = 110°. Then reason: ∠A, that is ∠BAC, is an inscribed angle formed by chords AB and AC, and it intercepts the same arc BC. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the inscribed angle subtending the same arc is equal to half of the central angle, so ∠A = 1/2 × ∠BOC = 1/2 × 110° = 55°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle with center O and triangle ABC inscribed in it; A, B, and C lie on the circumference, and the central angle formed by radii OB and OC is given as 110°. Identify ∠A as the inscribed angle ∠BAC whose sides are chords AB and AC, intercepting the same arc BC as central angle ∠BOC. Apply the inscribed-angle theorem: an inscribed angle equals half the corresponding central angle. Therefore ∠A = 110°/2 = 55°.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as an inscribed triangle ABC in a circle centered at O, with BOC marked as the central angle between radii OB and OC. Add the auxiliary radius OA. Let ∠BAO = x and ∠OAC = y, so ∠A = x + y. Since OA = OB, triangle AOB is isosceles, so ∠ABO = x and ∠AOB = 180° - 2x. Since OA = OC, triangle AOC is isosceles, so ∠ACO = y and ∠AOC = 180° - 2y. Around point O, the three central angles ∠AOB, ∠BOC, and ∠COA sum to 360°. Thus (180° - 2x) + 110° + (180° - 2y) = 360°, giving x + y = 55°. Therefore ∠A = 55°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个圆，三角形 ABC 的三个顶点 A、B、C 都在圆上；O 位于圆内，表示圆心。图中连接了 OB 和 OC，题目给出中心角 ∠BOC = 110°。需要求圆周角 ∠A。推理：按方法作辅助半径 OA。设 ∠BAO = x，∠OAC = y，则 ∠A = x + y。因为 OA = OB，△AOB 是等腰三角形，所以 ∠ABO = x，∠AOB = 180° - 2x。因为 OA = OC，△AOC 是等腰三角形，所以 ∠ACO = y，∠AOC = 180° - 2y。圆心 O 周围的三个中心角 ∠AOB、∠BOC、∠COA 相加为 360°，所以 (180° - 2x) + 110° + (180° - 2y) = 360°。化简得 470° - 2x - 2y = 360°，因此 2x + 2y = 110°，x + y = 55°。所以 ∠A = 55°。
